name: Block Drag Links
changes: When the settings refuse a Pro choice, for example in Readable block IDs, the keyboard focus now stays on that setting.
tip: Hold Ctrl or Cmd when you drop a block to insert an embed instead of a link.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Block Drag Links is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for trusting it with your notes.
